# US ethanol quota unit evidence

Retrieved 15 September 2026 from the official UK Online Trade Tariff:

https://www.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/uk/api/commodities/2207100090?as_of=2026-09-15&filter%5Bgeographical_area_id%5D=US

The adjacent JSON retains the complete response. Quota measure 20264391 (type 143, preference 320) links order 059750 to definition 32014. Its unit is `Litre (l)`, without a qualifier or monetary unit, for calendar year 2026. The public balance is not evidence of an individual allocation.

This fixture validates unit and measure selection only. It does not prove excise, VAT, document conditions, origin eligibility or an actual allocation. Synthetic allocation evidence in tests must never be used in a declaration.
